name: Yasova Dragonclaw
description: Yasova Dragonclaw is the Temur khan, a shaman who earned the title of dragonclaw and is later known as First Mother and grandmother of the twins Naiva and Baishya.

summary.text: Yasova Dragonclaw is the Temur khan, a shaman who earned the title of dragonclaw and is later known as First Mother and grandmother of the twins Naiva and Baishya.

bio.text: As khan of the Temur Frontier she met Sarkhan, who had arrived in Tarkir's past, and told him she followed a vision given by Bolas, after which Sarkhan transformed into a dragon and flew off.
She later confessed that she had helped a malevolent dragon spirit attack Ugin in hopes of ending the storms, and the khans forgave her despite Reyhan blaming her for thousands of deaths.
When dragons assaulted Dirgur, Reyhan died helping Yasova and Alesha escape, and Yasova afterward led her warriors to Ayagor and fed a mammoth to Atarka, asking to stop fighting.
Eighteen years after Ugin's death she appears as a former chief, called First Mother, leading a hunting party toward Ugin's grave, in a time when Atarka had banned the name Dragonclaw.
On the journey she healed Tae Jin, secretly signaled the hunters to kill an Ojutai broodling, and bargained with Atarka for the band's lives by claiming Tae Jin had come to serve her.
She revealed that Bolas had killed Ugin and had used her as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
At the grave she showed the twins a hidden sanctuary of carved ancestral memories, then entered the hedron to reach Ugin through Baishya while Bolas demanded that she be brought to him.
She surrendered herself to Bolas as a gamble and made him flee by bluffing that the Immortal Sun would trap him.

status.text: As of the latest story she is alive, having survived the confrontation with Bolas alongside Baishya, and is telling the girls they must safeguard memory.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan, arrived in Tarkir's past, follows the woman with the dragon-claw staff up a mountain by her trail of marks.
timeline.quote: gouged two sweeping curves into it with the clawed staff she carried.

timeline.summary: Yasova's sabertooth tackles Sarkhan from behind and pins him in the snow.
timeline.quote: Something slammed into him from behind, huge and living and warm.

timeline.summary: Yasova questions Sarkhan, who says he follows the whispers of Ugin and thinks she may be his spirit guide.
timeline.quote: I seek the great dragon Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan gives his name; she greets him mockingly as 'khan of khans,' and he declines to claim dominion, bowing and flattering her as he once did Bolas.
timeline.quote: Yasova Dragonclaw of the Temur pays her respects to you, O khan of khans, and bids you welcome to her lands.

timeline.summary: Yasova threatens to kill Sarkhan unless he gives a reason to be spared; he kneels and offers to serve her.
timeline.quote: Give me a reason to spare you, Vol, or I'll kill you and be on my way.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan tells Yasova that in his homeland there are no dragons or dragon tempests, only bones, and that Ugin is long dead.
timeline.quote: Not in all of Tarkir," he said. "Only bones.

timeline.summary: Yasova confirms that she believes the dragons fall if Ugin dies, and Sarkhan realizes a storm guided him to her.
timeline.quote: If Ugin dies, the storms cease. The dragons fall.

timeline.summary: Yasova furiously rejects Sarkhan's claim that her people are better than the weak khans of his time, saying she has seen a paradise with no dragons.
timeline.quote: But I've seen the unwritten myself, seen a world with no dragons. And it was paradise.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals that a great golden dragon appeared in her vision and asked her to chart the storms so that he could find and kill Ugin.
timeline.quote: He told me that if I showed him the way to the spirit dragon's lair…he would kill Ugin.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon, breathes fire to push Yasova aside rather than fight, and flies off to protect Ugin.
timeline.quote: With a kick from his powerful legs, Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Reyhan, Yasova, and Tasigur arrive at Dirgur and bicker.
timeline.quote: Such bravado!" said Tasigur.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses that she helped a malevolent dragon spirit attack Ugin in hopes of ending the storms.
timeline.quote: I saw that the storms would cease if I helped a malevolent dragon spirit kill the great Ugin.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that the sar-khan encased Ugin in a stone cocoon after she healed him, causing the tempests to return fourfold.
timeline.quote: He encased Ugin in a great stone cocoon inscribed with draconic runes.

timeline.summary: Reyhan blames Yasova for the deaths of thousands, but Shu Yun interposes under his truce, and the khans forgive her.
timeline.quote: Shu Yun interposed himself between Reyhan and Yasova.

timeline.summary: The khans realize someone leaked the summit, and Alesha suspects Shu Yun, who denies it; Tasigur has vanished.
timeline.quote: Someone must have told them about our little summit," said Reyhan.

timeline.summary: Tasigur's guards attack, and Alesha's party kills them.
timeline.quote: Alesha and her bodyguards charged, and the room erupted in chaos.

timeline.summary: Reyhan is killed by Silumgar while holding off dragons as Yasova and Alesha escape across the lake.
timeline.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

timeline.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
timeline.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

timeline.summary: Yasova leads her warriors to Ayagor and feeds a mammoth to Atarka as a gift, asking to stop fighting.
timeline.quote: I don't want to fight you anymore. I'm tired of fighting. That was a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

timeline.summary: Yasova carves an ivory image of the Temur offering meat to Atarka and says the future is not yet written.
timeline.quote: The future isn't yet written," she said. "It's up to us to write it, together.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
timeline.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
timeline.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

timeline.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
timeline.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

timeline.summary: The twins find the hunting party alive on a hill above the flood, and Yasova asks Baishya to report what happened.
timeline.quote: Grandmother was tending to several injured people.

timeline.summary: Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
timeline.quote: Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

timeline.summary: In the vision Ugin calls Yasova Dragonclaw to come to him.
timeline.quote: Someone is looking for you, Yasova Dragonclaw. Come to me.

timeline.summary: Three of Atarka's broodlings land at the camp demanding the clan surrender its shamans.
timeline.quote: We smell magic in the air. Surrender your shamans to us, or we will kill you all.

timeline.summary: Yasova lies that the camp stood on the hill and distracts the broodlings with the goblin corpses.
timeline.quote: For your trouble, and out of respect, we have gathered a little snack for you.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party sees an Ojutai dragon hunting on the high plateau, and Yasova decides to avoid it on the way to Ugin's grave.
timeline.quote: I want to reach Ugin's grave without tangling with that dragon.

timeline.summary: Yasova praises Naiva and sends her and Baishya to scout a ring of stones where vultures are perched.
timeline.quote: If the vultures are not afraid, then we need not be.

timeline.summary: Yasova suspects a trap by Ojutai's broodling but Naiva and Baishya insist she heal him.
timeline.quote: This could be a trap on the part of Ojutai to find me.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin explains his master's dream and that Ojutai destroyed records but the Spirit Dragon's story survives by oral tradition.
timeline.quote: He wants to destroy our memory of the past, and of our ancestors

timeline.summary: Yasova heals Tae Jin's wound with magic and tells him to prove his words.
timeline.quote: She pulled off her glove and placed a bare hand, fingers spread, atop the wound.

timeline.summary: An Ojutai broodling appears and its aven interpreter sentences Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.
timeline.quote: Tae Jin, by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege and sentenced to die by ice.

timeline.summary: As the Ojutai broodling prepares to kill Tae Jin, Yasova secretly signals the hunters to kill.
timeline.quote: Keeping her hand hidden from the aven on the rock, Grandmother gestured Kill .

timeline.summary: Baishya rolls a boulder to block the broodling's ice breath, and Naiva and Yasova kill the aven interpreter with spears.
timeline.quote: Grandmother cast her own spear, and the weapon struck the aven's head for the death blow.

timeline.summary: Yasova decides to go on to Ugin's grave, accepting the portent of Tae Jin's arrival and the windfolk's vision.
timeline.quote: We will go on to Ugin's grave.

timeline.summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to continue Ugin's story, especially about Bolas.
timeline.quote: Tell me more about Ugin. And about Bolas.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party camps; at dusk Naiva tells Tae Jin that Yasova brings children to Ugin's grave to wake their magic early.
timeline.quote: Atarka hates magic. She fears it.

timeline.summary: Naiva kills the broodling by driving her spear through its eye.
timeline.quote: Naiva thrust the obsidian point of her spear into the dragon's unblinking eye

timeline.summary: Yasova identifies Tae Jin's dragon mark as that of a ghostfire warrior and demands to know how he exists.
timeline.quote: You wear the dragon mark of a ghostfire warrior.

timeline.summary: Yasova demands the truth from Tae Jin after finding he is a ghostfire warrior, threatening to kill him.
timeline.quote: All our lives are forfeit if the dragons discover we have sheltered a ghostfire warrior.

timeline.summary: Fec warns of an approaching dragon tempest, and the party shelters in a rock chamber.
timeline.quote: It's a dragon tempest, and it's moving in fast,

timeline.summary: Yasova asks Tae Jin to resume his story of Ugin and Nicol.
timeline.quote: There is more to your story. I'll listen.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin ends his story, and Yasova says she witnessed Ugin's death eighteen years ago and another dragon who vanished in golden light.
timeline.quote: Eighteen years ago, I witnessed a battle in the sky that ended with the death of Ugin.

timeline.summary: Yasova reveals Bolas killed Ugin and that she was used as a tool, and that hedrons cast by Sarkhan Vol preserved some essence of Ugin.
timeline.quote: That dragon, called Bolas, killed Ugin.

timeline.summary: A dragon tempest breaks and Mattak asks Yasova to come see something.
timeline.quote: First Mother, you'd best come see.

timeline.summary: A dragon tempest passes over the camp; Atarka arrives, finds her dead broodling, and drives the newborn dragons back into the storm.
timeline.quote: Slashing and raging, she drove the fledglings deeper into the night.

timeline.summary: Atarka lands between the hunting band and the shelter, seizes Darka, and eats him.
timeline.quote: She bit off Darka's head before tossing his body in a high arc.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Atarka that Ojutai's kin killed her broodling and that the hunters have killed the outsider as a feast for her.
timeline.quote: One of Ojutai's kin killed your broodling and fed on its innards.

timeline.summary: Atarka forces the party to follow her to the corpse and spots Tae Jin as an outsider smelling of Ojutai.
timeline.quote: He smells of Ojutai, that pompous, ice-breathing windbag.

timeline.summary: Yasova claims Tae Jin has come to serve Atarka and stops him from raising his ghostfire blade.
timeline.quote: Do not begin that which you cannot end.

timeline.summary: Atarka agrees to hear a story while she eats the Ojutai dragon before deciding Tae Jin's fate.
timeline.quote: Tell a story while I feast. Then I decide.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin says the story came to him in a whisper, and Yasova warns that once before a whispering voice altered Tarkir and that she listened to it.
timeline.quote: Once before, a whispering voice sought to alter the events on Tarkir.

timeline.summary: The hunters honor Darka in the ainok manner and set out for Ugin's grave.
timeline.quote: His spirit walks ahead of us into the unwritten now,

timeline.summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
timeline.quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

timeline.summary: Receiving no answer, Yasova sends Fec ahead to the cave and orders others to guard Tae Jin against possible Ojutai trickery.
timeline.quote: It might be. I want you to guard Tae Jin from attack by any of his Ojutai brethren

timeline.summary: Yasova leads the twins through a secret tunnel into a warm hidden sanctuary and then a cavern of whisperer headpieces and carvings.
timeline.quote: They are the garb of a whisperer, as you are meant to be.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors.
timeline.quote: It's past time for you girls to become guardians of this knowledge, so you can pass it on after I am gone.

timeline.summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
timeline.quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the twins she suspects the speaker is not Mevra, orders them to stay hidden, and says to return to Ayagor after a month if she does not come back.
timeline.quote: After a month, return to Ayagor and tell Gerrak he is now First Father of the tribe.

timeline.summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
timeline.quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

timeline.summary: Yasova crawls into the hedron to reach Ugin through Baishya, after warning Naiva that Mevra and the others are probably dead.
timeline.quote: She crawled in through the tiny opening, disappearing inside the hedron structure.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens to destroy Tarkir unless Naiva brings Yasova to him, and promises to clear her enemies.
timeline.quote: All you need do is bring me Yasova. Now.

timeline.summary: Naiva tells Bolas that Yasova is hiding right there.
timeline.quote: She's here. Right here. Hiding.

timeline.summary: Naiva crawls into the hedron, finds Baishya and Yasova, and presses her knife to Baishya's throat.
timeline.quote: Pulling her knife from its sheath, she pressed the blade against Baishya's vulnerable throat.

timeline.summary: Naiva, her mind twisted by Bolas, holds a knife to Baishya's throat, then snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her and Yasova disarms her.
timeline.quote: Why was she holding a blade against her sister's throat?

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas killed Ugin and uses mind touch, and that she will be taken because he threatened Tarkir.
timeline.quote: The dragon who killed Ugin has returned.

timeline.summary: Yasova confesses she helped Bolas track Ugin and cast a spell that turned fledgling dragons against him, after being promised an end to dragons.
timeline.quote: I helped Bolas track down Ugin because he promised me an end to dragons on Tarkir.

timeline.summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
timeline.quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

timeline.summary: Naiva and Baishya wake from the memories and tell Yasova what they saw; Yasova decides to surrender herself to Bolas as a desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: The Spirit Dragon has not forgotten Tarkir. We have a chance to deflect Bolas.

timeline.summary: Yasova has Baishya wear Naiva's mantle and necklace to meet Bolas in Naiva's place.
timeline.quote: Baishya will wear your mantle and go out in your place.

timeline.summary: Yasova and Baishya face Bolas, taunting him that he came back to confirm Ugin was dead.
timeline.quote: You came back to see if he was really dead.

timeline.summary: Bolas threatens to devastate Tarkir and orders Naiva to kill Yasova, but Naiva resists in the hedron.
timeline.quote: Do it, Naiva. I command you! Kill her, and I will grant you all that you desire

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

timeline.summary: Naiva emerges to find the dragon gone and discovers Yasova and Baishya alive, shielded by Baishya's earth magic.
timeline.quote: A big boulder shifted with a great, grinding rumble.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

timeline.summary: The rest of the party arrives; Tae Jin tells Naiva he would never mistake her for her sister again.
timeline.quote: I wouldn't mistake you for your sister ever again.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must safeguard memory and asks Tae Jin to stay to recite Ugin's story to Fec for carving.
timeline.quote: I would like you to recite Ugin's story once again to Fec so it can be carved and preserved in more than one place.

timeline.summary: Yasova closes by telling the girls that even the greatest of dragons can die and that anything may come to pass in the unwritten now.
timeline.quote: Even the greatest of dragons can die.

relations.note: Her sabertooth companion, protective of her.
relations.quote: Anchin is very protective, and he won't be gentle with you a second time.

relations.note: She threatens him, then they part in a clash after he learns of Bolas.
relations.quote: or I'll kill you and be on my way.
Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

relations.note: Atarka hates magic and the whisperers Yasova hides
relations.quote: Grandmother thought if she could learn early which children are likely to become whisperers, she could better hide them from Atarka's wrath.

relations.note: a trusted hunter who defers to the First Mother
relations.quote: The First Mother had spoken, so it was settled.

relations.note: sheltered by her as one of the tribe

relations.quote: now fostered son to Yasova First Mother

relations.note: related through grandmothers who were sisters
relations.quote: She was related to Grandmother through grandmothers who were sisters
Fetch her for me. Then you will receive your reward.

relations.note: carves records for her hidden collection
relations.quote: one that would be added to the scrimshaw collection hidden in the caves

pages_say.description: The Temur khan, a powerful shaman who earned the title of dragonclaw and is accompanied by an enormous sabertooth.
The Temur khan of the past, a dragon slayer with a glowing dragon-claw staff who has seen a vision of a dragonless Tarkir.
The Temur khan who confesses her role in Ugin's injury and later seeks an arrangement with Atarka.
The Temur khan Sarkhan met in the past, whose attack on a brood he remembers.
The ancient Temur khan who meets Sarkhan in Tarkir's past and unwittingly helps Bolas defeat Ugin.
The twins' grandmother and a former clan chief who leads the hunting band and hides the dragon claw staff from Atarka.
The former chief of the Temur and grandmother of the twins, a healer and keeper of the past, who leads the party toward Ugin's grave.
The former Temur chief and leader of the hunting party, who secretly signals to kill the Ojutai broodling and guides the party to Ugin's grave.
The former Temur chief, now called First Mother, who confronts Tae Jin and reveals she witnessed Bolas kill Ugin eighteen years ago.
The former Temur chief who bargains with Atarka for the hunting band's lives.
The leader of the party who shows her granddaughters a hidden sanctuary and goes into the hedron to reach Ugin.
The former Temur chief meditating in the hedron beside Baishya, sought by Bolas.
The former Temur chief who confesses she helped Bolas against Ugin, then outwits Bolas with a bluff about Ugin's trap.
